symbols.name: vector norm
symbols.meaning: The largest modulus among the coordinates of the vector u.
symbols.quote: The norm of $u$, written $\|u\|$, is the largest modulus (absolute value) among its coordinates.

symbols.name: operator norm
symbols.meaning: The largest factor by which L stretches a vector of norm at most one.
symbols.quote: Here $\sup$ denotes the supremum, the least upper bound, so the operator norm $\|L\|$ is the least upper bound of $\|Lu\|$ over all vectors $u$ with $\|u\|\le 1$

symbols.name: second map
symbols.meaning: A second linear map whose output length matches the input length of L.
symbols.quote: Let $M$ be a second linear map whose output length matches the input length of $L$, so that $LM$ is defined.

symbols.name: contraction A
symbols.meaning: A linear map that is a contraction, used as a factor on the Gaussian resampling page.
symbols.quote: On the [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) page, the factors $A$ and $B_0$ are linear maps that are contractions, so they cannot increase the norm of what they are applied to.

relations.quote: The operator norm is defined for any [linear map](linear-map.md) $L$, and it is the largest factor by which $L$ stretches a vector.
